# origincloud_support_case_messages (Data Source)

Lists a case's messages, oldest first. Needs `admin.support_case.get` on the organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `case` (String) The case whose case messages to list.
- `organization` (String) The organization whose case messages to list.

### Read-Only

- `case_messages` (Attributes List) The case messages listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--case_messages))

<a id="nestedatt--case_messages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `case_messages`

Read-Only:

- `author` (String) The principal that wrote the message, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`.
- `body` (String) The message's text. Not empty.
- `create_time` (String) When the message was added. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `name` (String) The message's resource name, `organizations/{organization}/cases/{case}/messages/{message}`.
